description: This file defines classes and interfaces related to secure socket communication, including certificate management, key handling, certificate store, and secure socket port implementation with SSL/TLS support.

classes.name: Certificate
classes.description: Represents an X.509 certificate, providing methods to access issuer, subject, validity period, and hostname validation.

classes.name: Key
classes.description: Handles cryptographic keys, supporting loading from files or memory.

classes.name: CertificateStore
classes.description: Manages a store of X.509 certificates, allowing addition and default store retrieval.

classes.name: SecureSocketPort
classes.description: Implements a secure socket port with SSL/TLS, including certificate validation, data transmission, and connection management.

classes.name: SecureSocketServerType
classes.description: Defines a server type with associated certificate and key for secure socket servers.

methods.name: Certificate::Issuer
methods.description: Returns the issuer of the certificate.

methods.name: Certificate::Subject
methods.description: Returns the subject of the certificate.

methods.name: Certificate::ValidFrom
methods.description: Returns the start of the certificate's validity period.

methods.name: Certificate::ValidTill
methods.description: Returns the end of the certificate's validity period.

methods.name: Certificate::ValidHostname
methods.description: Checks if the certificate's hostname matches the expected hostname.

methods.name: Key::operator const evp_pkey_st*
methods.description: Returns the underlying OpenSSL EVP_PKEY structure.

methods.name: CertificateStore::Add
methods.description: Adds a certificate to the store.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Certificate
methods.description: Sets the certificate and key for the secure socket port.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::Root
methods.description: Sets the trusted root certificates for the socket port.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::SendData
methods.description: Sends data over the secure socket.

methods.name: SecureSocketPort::ReceiveData
methods.description: Receives data from the secure socket.
